notes.title: Urban Justice - Update 2.0.2.06
notes.notes:
[h1]Urban Justice Update - 2.0.2.06 is now live![/h1]

Hello everybody! As we mentioned in our previous update announcement, we were working on adding more flexibility to the controller options for the new multiplayer co-op game modes. With this update, we are introducing a new option called "Controller Affinity", with several minor fixes.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added "Controller Affinity" option to game menu
[*] Updated input manager to support new functionality
[*] Updated player controller to support new functionality
[*] Adjusted player 2 spawn points on Skirmish levels
[/list]

[h1]Controller Affinity[/h1]
With the new "Controller Affinity" options, players can now select two different input models, this option is mostly useful when only one controller is connected, and allows player 1 to be controlled with keyboard and player 2 to be controlled with a controller. This option is available in game options and can be switched on the fly.

In case of two controllers being connected, the "Controller Affinity" option will swap the controllers between characters.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194632/0b783538a62f933e95738354906ced2d48f100cf.png[/img]

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
Your feedback is very important to us, please leave your thoughts and concerns on the Forum.

Thank you,
Evil Bunneh Team

notes.title: Urban Justice - Update 2.0.1.05
notes.notes:
[h1]Urban Justice Co-op Multiplayer Update - 2.0.1.05 is now live![/h1]

Hello everybody! We are very happy to announce that we are introducing a new Co-op Multiplayer mode into the game with this update! Additionally, this update introduces changes to the player controller.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Co-op Multiplayer game mode added
[*] How To Play menu section updated with 2 player controls
[*] Player controller adjusted to support new functionality
[*] Removed joystick checkbox from menu as it is no longer required
[*] Story Mode expanded to support Co-op dynamic drop in
[*] Skirmish Mode expanded to support 2 player Co-op mode
[*] Expanded HUD graphics and workflow to support new functionality
[*] Enemy AI has been updated to support new game features
[/list]

[h1]New Player Controls[/h1]
With the introduction of 2 Player Co-op game modes, the controls have been updated to support this new functionality.

However, we realize that there is still room for improvement and currently working on granting more control options. Currently the game supports two controllers and two keyboard layouts, the input can be found under the "How to Play" section in the main menu. 

We are working on proving the options to player to be able to select the desired control model. This will become available with our next update.

[h1]Story Mode Co-op[/h1]
With this update we introduce a dynamic drop in Co-op multiplayer into the Urban Justice story mode. Players will now be able to join in anytime by pressing the Player 2 start button. In story mode the characters are predefined for each act, for both players.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194632/0af3b7e7a9a2371516019aa0636712a816e2c70f.png[/img]

[h1]Skirmish Mode Co-op[/h1]
The Skirmish game mode now fully supports 2 Player Co-op, with all of the characters available. Players can now select "Solo" or "Co-op" when starting a Skirmish game, and select the characters for each player.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34194632/22924c0b54280ac25b05a2a82dacd748b5d39ac6.png[/img]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
As we mentioned before, we are going to focus on developing additional options for player to configure the input models for multiplayer. This will require some additional time and effort on our side.

[h1]Feedback[/h1]
Your feedback is very important to us, please leave your thoughts and concerns on the Forum.

Thank you,
Evil Bunneh Team

notes.title: Urban Justice - Update 1.0.2.02
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.0.2.02 Patch Notes[/h1]

This is the second update that has been rolled out. With this update we added the "How to Play" section in the main menu that will have the basic controls layout for keyboard and controller. 

Additionally, we have reduced the number of coins it is required to unlock new characters in preparation for future expansions.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

* Added "How to Play" section in main menu
* Reduced required coins to unlock characters

We are looking forward to hearing feedback from you.

Thank you,
Evil Bunneh Team.

notes.title: Urban Justice - Update 1.0.1.06
notes.notes:
[h1]Update 1.0.1.06 Patch Notes[/h1]

This is the first update that has been rolled out since release and it addresses some of the issues that were reported to us, and introduces several adjustments into the gameplay based on the feedback received.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

* Fixed the issue where enemies would sometimes get stuck on Act 6
* Fixed the issue where enemies would spawn too close to player on Act 7
* Fixed the issue where final boss would sometimes have random name
* Fixed the issue where coins would not be granted sometimes
* Increased the amount of health gained when picking up food items
* Overall player health slightly increased

We are looking forward to hearing feedback from you.

Thank you,
Evil Bunneh Team.
